mentions.name: SellerMate
mentions.description: This web app handles order queueing and sales recording for small coffee shops. It stores data locally and remains fully functional offline, with an optional sign-up-based syncing feature to share data across multiple devices using PouchDB/CouchDB. It is built as a Progressive Web App with Web Components and is completely free to use.
mentions.audience: Small coffee shops (built primarily for a friend's coffee shop)
